channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Trump administration denies Minnesota access to FBI evidence
item.description: The Trump administration has formally denied Minnesota law enforcement access to information and evidence from the FBI investigation into the shooting death of Alex Pretti by federal agents on Jan. 24 in Minneapolis.

item.title: Agency representing Dodgers’ Yamamoto, Chappell Roan for sale amid Epstein fallout
item.description: LOS ANGELES >> Casey Wasserman, a Los Angeles entertainment executive and chair of the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics whose name recently surfaced in the Epstein files, said late Friday that he has started the process of selling the talent agency he founded more than two decades ago.

item.title: Man, 22, shot by police after domestic dispute in Halawa
item.description: Honolulu police shot and seriously injured a 22-year-old man who was allegedly wielding a knife after he punched his little brother and sister Sunday night.

item.title: U.K. eyes social media ban for under-16s and AI curbs
item.description: LONDON >> Britain could bring in an Australian-style ban on social media for children under 16 as early as this year and close a loophole that left some AI chatbots outside safety rules, as part of government efforts to respond more quickly to digital risks.

item.title: High surf advisory for east shores extended to Tuesday evening
item.description: A high surf advisory remains in place for the east-facing shores of all isles through 6 p.m. Tuesday.

item.title: Hale Nani strike averted after tentative agreement reached
item.description: Unionized health care workers at Hale Nani Rehabilitation & Nursing Center said they have reached a tentative agreement with management and will no longer be going on strike.

item.title: Man in critical condition after being pulled from Ko Olina lagoon
item.description: A man in his 40s was in critical condition after being pulled from the waters at Ko Olina Lagoon this afternoon, according to Honolulu Emergency Medical Services.

item.title: U.S. vaccine makers curtail research and cut jobs
item.description: In Massachusetts, Moderna is pulling back on vaccine studies. In Texas, a small company canceled plans to build a factory that would have created new jobs manufacturing a technology used in vaccines. In San Diego, another manufacturing company laid off workers.

item.title: 2 killed in shooting at high school hockey game in Rhode Island
item.description: Gunfire erupted at an ice skating rink in Pawtucket, Rhode Island, during a high school hockey game today, leaving three people dead, including the shooter, authorities said.

item.title: Walk-off win clinches series for Hawaii baseball team
item.description: Elijah Ickes sprinted home on a wild pitch in the ninth inning to deliver the Hawaii baseball team a 4-3 victory over Gonzaga today at Les Murakami Stadium.
